adjustedAfterLooking.why: Scale: the host's static punch-ins measured against fixed room objects (shelf, plush owl) are about 1.2x at cut 1:06.366|1:06.533, about 1.1x at 0:57.024|0:57.190 and about 1.3x at 0:38.272|0:38.438; face size alone overstates it because she also leans toward the lens. Cut rate: the cut sheets show every detected cut in the first 60 s (15). Only 6 are host-to-host jump cuts (0:15.8, 0:38.3, 0:40.0, 0:55.2, 0:57.1, 0:58.9). The other 9 are the clip panel entering or leaving, a cut inside the reacted Short, a meme sticker popping on, and the white flash at frame 0. Of all 24 cuts checked (to 1:15), 8 are host cuts, so the 21.37/min overall is mostly clip, layout and graphic changes that the rough cut does not make. The overall host rate past 1:15 was not checked cut by cut, so 6 is used for both. Continuous talk will still cut faster, because maxHoldSec 4 forces a change at least every 4 s. That matches the reference's commentary stretches, where host shots last about 1.2-2.6 s. minSegmentSec: the 0.73 s p10 shot comes from the 1:13-1:15 intro montage (clip swaps 0.5-0.7 s apart) and the 0.33 s colour bars. The shortest host shot among the inspected cuts is about 1.2 s (1:05.2 to 1:06.4).
